svg.title: Greek Theogony
svg.desc: A visual map of ancient Greek gods, collective divine races, immediate families and selected parent traditions.

text.tspan: Ancestry runs outwards from Chaos at the centre, one

text.style: font-family:"Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:20px
text.tspan: A coloured region surrounds the children of one parent.
It is drawn in that parent's group colour. Where two
regions overlap, the figures inside share both parents.
Zeus, for example, sits where Cronus's region (Earth &

text.style: font-family:"Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:20px;fill:#77746d
text.tspan: Stacked cards are collectives. Leto, Maia, Metis,
Semele and Clymene have no recorded parents here,
so each sits in the same ring as their partner.

text.style: font-family:"Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:20px;fill:#77746d
text.tspan: *Nereus is also the father of the Nereids, with Doris.
